# Fixing shorted transmission solenoid wiring

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Locate exposed wires on the passenger side inner fender wall that are shorting 12V from the TCM to the solenoid. [t1074]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Remove the battery to isolate the electrical system.
2. Locate exposed wires on the passenger side inner fender wall that are shorting 12V from the TCM to the solenoid.
3. Cut the shorted wires shorter than before.

_Procedure reported by [t1074]._

## Tools

- [Partial] Heat shrink tubing [t1074]

## Tips & gotchas

- Add wireloom insulation over the repaired section for extra protection against rubbing. [t1074]
- [Partial] Ensure the resistor is replaced after fixing any wiring shorts. [t1074]
